description: Read a site's brand from one rendered page load: the name, description, tagline and calls to action (`identity`), logo links (`logos`, with a small logo's inline SVG), icons, brand colours with their roles (`colors`), fonts with their files (`fonts`), images such as the Open Graph image (`images`), video links with poster images (`videos`, never direct video files) and social profile links (`socials`). Use it when you need a company's logo, colours or fonts for a design or a summary of how it presents itself. Every value is a link or a plain value; nothing is downloaded. Pass `include` to ask for only some sections, since each section is capped. It is charged like a JavaScript-rendered scrape (3 credits typically), and a failed call costs 0. A cache hit is billed too. Each call bills again. Read-only.

include.description: Sections to return, without repeats. Omit to get all of them. Only these appear in the response.

url.description: The page to read, http or https. Usually the site's home page. Private addresses are refused.

name: spicrawl_brand

engine.description: The rendering tier used: fetch, js or browser.

final_url.description: The URL the page loaded from, after redirects.

cta.description: Up to two hero calls to action.

subtitle.description: The line under the hero headline. Empty when there is none.

tagline.description: The hero headline. Empty when there is none.

theme_color.description: Hex colour of the theme-color meta tag, or null.

warnings.description: Sections that failed on the page. They are empty and the request still succeeded.

title: Extract a site's brand
